title: Users
description: Find an account and see what it did.

list.name: search
list.label: Search
list.description: Part of an email or username

list.name: user
list.label: Picked account
list.description: The id of the account shown at the top. Click an email in the Users table to change it.

panels.title: Account
panels.description: The account picked in the Users table. Its id is in the Picked account box at the top.

targets.rawSql:
WITH u AS (SELECT * FROM stats.users WHERE id = (NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(${user:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9), '')::int))
SELECT k AS "Account", v AS "Value" FROM (
  SELECT t.* FROM u, LATERAL (VALUES
    (1, 'Email', u.email),
    (2, 'Username', u.username),
    (3, 'Plan', initcap(u.plan)),
    (4, 'Signed up', to_char(u.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD Mon YYYY HH24:MI')),
    (5, 'Last active', (SELECT to_char(max(day), 'DD Mon YYYY') FROM stats.activity_days WHERE user_id = u.id)),
    (6, 'Country', coalesce(u.country, 'Unknown')),
    (7, 'Language', CASE u.language WHEN 'en' THEN 'English' WHEN 'fr' THEN 'French' WHEN 'es' THEN 'Spanish' WHEN 'de' THEN 'German' WHEN 'ar' THEN 'Arabic' WHEN 'ru' THEN 'Russian' WHEN 'zh' THEN 'Chinese (Simplified)' WHEN 'zh-Hant' THEN 'Chinese (Traditional)' ELSE u.language END),
    (8, 'Trial ends', to_char(u.trial_ends_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD Mon YYYY')),
    (9, 'Premium', CASE u.premium_source
                     WHEN 'granted' THEN 'Granted' || coalesce(' until ' || to_char(u.premium_expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD Mon YYYY'), ' for good')
                     WHEN 'purchased' THEN 'Bought, ' || CASE WHEN u.premium_renews THEN 'renews ' ELSE 'ends ' END
                                           || to_char(u.premium_expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD Mon YYYY')
                   END),
    (10, 'Banned', to_char(u.banned_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD Mon YYYY HH24:MI'))
  ) AS t (pos, k, v)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 0, 'No account picked', 'Click an email in the Users table below' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM u)
) AS rows
WHERE v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pos

panels.title: In this time range
panels.description: What the picked account did in the time range at the top. Refused questions were out of scope.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM stats.activity_days WHERE user_id = (NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(${user:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9), '')::int) AND day BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz)::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)::date) AS "Active days",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM stats.questions WHERE user_id = (NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(${user:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9), '')::int) AND $__timeFilter(created_at)) AS "Questions",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM stats.questions WHERE user_id = (NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(${user:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9), '')::int) AND NOT answered AND $__timeFilter(created_at)) AS "Refused",
       (SELECT coalesce(sum(cost_usd), 0) FROM stats.question_costs WHERE user_id = (NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(${user:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9), '')::int) AND $__timeFilter(created_at)) AS "Claude cost",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM stats.records WHERE user_id = (NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(${user:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9), '')::int) AND $__timeFilter(created_at)) AS "Records added"
WHERE (NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(${user:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9), '')::int) IS NOT NULL

panels.title: All time
panels.description: Everything the picked account has now, whatever the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM stats.pets WHERE user_id = (NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(${user:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9), '')::int)) AS "Pets",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM stats.records WHERE user_id = (NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(${user:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9), '')::int)) AS "Records",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM stats.photos WHERE user_id = (NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(${user:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9), '')::int)) AS "Photos",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM stats.walks WHERE user_id = (NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(${user:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9), '')::int)) AS "Walks",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM stats.feedings WHERE user_id = (NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(${user:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9), '')::int)) AS "Feedings"
WHERE (NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(${user:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9), '')::int) IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Get started
panels.description: The picked account's Get started steps, and when each was done.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT steps.label AS "Step", o.done_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS "Done"
FROM (VALUES (1, 'pet', 'Add your pet'), (2, 'record', 'Add a health record'), (3, 'photo', 'Attach a photo to a record'), (4, 'question', 'Ask Companion a question'), (5, 'appointment', 'Schedule an appointment'), (6, 'tracking', 'Meet the trackers')) AS steps (pos, step, label)
LEFT JOIN stats.onboarding_steps o ON o.step = steps.step AND o.user_id = (NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(${user:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9), '')::int)
WHERE (NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(${user:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9), '')::int) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY steps.pos

panels.title: Billing events
panels.description: The picked account's real purchases, renewals, cancellations and refunds, newest first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS "When", initcap(replace(type, '_', ' ')) AS "Event", CASE store WHEN 'PLAY_STORE' THEN 'Google Play' WHEN 'APP_STORE' THEN 'App Store' WHEN 'STRIPE' THEN 'Stripe' ELSE initcap(store) END AS "Store",
       product_id AS "Product", price_usd AS "Paid", initcap(replace(cancel_reason, '_', ' ')) AS "Reason"
FROM stats.billing_events
WHERE user_id = (NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(${user:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9), '')::int) AND environment = 'PRODUCTION'
ORDER BY occurred_at DESC

panels.title: Admin actions
panels.description: What was done to the picked account from the server's command line, newest first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS "When", initcap(action) AS "Action", reason AS "Reason", detail AS "Detail"
FROM stats.admin_actions
WHERE user_id = (NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(${user:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9), '')::int) OR email = (SELECT email FROM stats.users WHERE id = (NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(${user:sqlstring}, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 9), '')::int))
ORDER BY created_at DESC

panels.title: Users
panels.description: Newest first, up to 500. Type in the Search box at the top to find an account by email or username, and click an email to see that account above. Active days and Questions count the time range at the top.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT u.id, u.email AS "Email", u.username AS "Username", initcap(u.plan) AS "Plan", coalesce(u.country, '') AS "Country",
       CASE u.language WHEN 'en' THEN 'English' WHEN 'fr' THEN 'French' WHEN 'es' THEN 'Spanish' WHEN 'de' THEN 'German' WHEN 'ar' THEN 'Arabic' WHEN 'ru' THEN 'Russian' WHEN 'zh' THEN 'Chinese (Simplified)' WHEN 'zh-Hant' THEN 'Chinese (Traditional)' ELSE u.language END AS "Language", u.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS "Signed up",
       (SELECT max(day) FROM stats.activity_days a WHERE a.user_id = u.id)::timestamptz AS "Last active",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM stats.activity_days a WHERE a.user_id = u.id AND a.day BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz)::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)::date) AS "Active days",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM stats.questions q WHERE q.user_id = u.id AND $__timeFilter(q.created_at)) AS "Questions",
       (SELECT count(*) FROM stats.pets p WHERE p.user_id = u.id) AS "Pets"
FROM stats.users u
WHERE ${search:sqlstring} = ''
   OR u.email ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%'
   OR u.username ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%'
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Admin actions, every account
panels.description: Every ban, unban, grant, revoke and delete made from the server's command line, newest first, up to 200. A deleted account keeps its entries, with the email it had.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS "When", initcap(a.action) AS "Action", a.email AS "Email",
       a.reason AS "Reason", a.detail AS "Detail", a.user_id AS id
FROM stats.admin_actions a
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
LIMIT 200
